name: Invalid-position fail-block gate
summary: Blocks the assigned operation when its required position inputs form an invalid combination.
description: Blocks the assigned operation when its required position inputs form an invalid combination. An interlocking function permits or blocks an operation according to the positions and conditions of related equipment. Electrical, mechanical and trapped-key interlocks implement different parts of a coordinated operating philosophy.

In a switchgear feeder panel, a control diagram can prevent an incompatible combination of breaker, disconnector and earthing-switch positions. The physical equipment documents determine which restrictions are mechanically enforced. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Invalid double-point status” at the input and “Operation inhibit” at the output. The fail response must be agreed for the application.
